summary: The change trims input before greeting and includes one security finding from deterministic analysis.

inlineFindings.title: Avoid passing request input to shell execution
inlineFindings.body: Validate the command against an allowlist before invoking the shell.
inlineFindings.suggestedFix: Replace the shell call with an allowlisted command dispatcher.

summaryFindings.title: Add coverage for whitespace-only names
summaryFindings.body: The greeting path now trims input, so a test should document blank and whitespace-only behavior.

testSuggestions: Add a unit test for names containing only whitespace.
